# EDA
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

df <- read.csv("dataset/spotify-tracks-dataset.csv")
head(df)
```

```{r}
# Density plots for numeric audio features
numeric_cols <- c("popularity", "danceability", "energy", "loudness",
                  "speechiness", "acousticness", "instrumentalness",
                  "liveness", "valence", "tempo")

df_long <- pivot_longer(df[, numeric_cols], cols = everything(),
                        names_to = "feature", values_to = "value")

ggplot(df_long, aes(x = value)) +
  geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~feature, scales = "free") +
  labs(title = "Density of Numeric Features", x = NULL, y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()
```
